folder.notWritable: Cannot write to the simpllm folder.
folder.notWritableDetail:
{root}
Move the whole folder to a place you can write to (for example C:\simpllm or inside Documents), then start again.
gpu.runtimeMissing: Files needed for the GPU seem to be missing.
gpu.runtimeMissingDetail:
There is no cudart64_*.dll in bin\. To use an NVIDIA GPU, also put the contents of the second zip (cudart-llama-bin-win-cuda-...zip) in bin\.
Startup continues, but it may be slow without the GPU, or fail. This notice is shown only once.

image.busyApply: This cannot be changed while an image is being processed. Apply it when that has finished.
image.busySwitch: Models cannot be switched while an image is being processed. Choose again when that has finished.

Put a model in the models folder of simpllm, or start again and choose the folder where your models are.

port.inUseDetail: Give another number with -Port, or start without it (a free number is chosen automatically).
port.internalFailed: An internal port could not be reserved. Start again.
port.noneFreeDetail: Close other apps and start again.
server.dllMissing: A DLL that llama-server.exe needs was not found. Check that everything in the llama.cpp zip (including the .dll files) is directly in bin\.
server.problem.arch: The installed llama.cpp does not support this kind of model. Put a newer llama.cpp in bin\.
server.problem.driver: The GPU driver is too old. Update the NVIDIA driver.
server.problem.file: The model file could not be loaded. The download may be incomplete, or the file may be damaged.
server.problem.memory: Not enough memory (GPU VRAM or main memory). Make the context length smaller under "Launch settings" in Settings (for example 8192), or use a smaller model.
server.problem.mmproj: The image input file (mmproj) could not be loaded. Turn off image input under "Launch settings" in Settings, or add an mmproj that matches the model.
server.problem.options: The installed llama.cpp does not support the launch options simpllm uses. Put another version of llama.cpp in bin\ (the README lists the version that was tested).
server.problem.path: The settings file could not be read because the folder path contains non-ASCII characters. Move simpllm to a folder with only letters and digits (for example C:\simpllm).
server.problem.port: A port used internally could not be reserved. Start again.
server.restartFailed: The server could not be restarted.
server.stopTimeout: The previous server did not stop in time.
server.unknownCause: The cause could not be determined. Last output of the server:
shortcut.failed: Could not create the desktop shortcut: {error}
start.alreadyRunning: simpllm is already running, or is still shutting down.
temp.deleteFailed: Could not delete the temporary image files: {path}
temp.isLink: A link cannot be deleted as the temporary image folder.
temp.notTemp: Only the temporary image folder can be deleted.
vision.noMmproj: Image input is on, but there is no mmproj*.gguf matching {file} in the same folder as the model.
